alsoug.com publishes neighbourhood-scoped rental indexes for Port Sudan (سلالاب, ترانزيت, حي المطار) — real supply, but individual landlord ads, not businesses. Catalogued as a channel, not crawled ad-by-ad.

Demand signal worth carrying: the largest Port Sudan rental ad found is a 15-room building at US$4,000/month advertised explicitly 'لاصحاب الشركات والمنظمات والمؤسسات والمكاتب والمستوصفات' — to companies, NGOs, institutions, offices and clinics. Port Sudan's rental demand is currently organisational relocation, not tourism, and it is priced in USD.

The classifieds broker layer is thin and concentrated: of 12 Port Sudan property ads on alsoug, one advertiser holds 8 and the rest are one-off individual sellers (Abu Salem, Nahla Abdalbdea, قباني). Individual sellers were deliberately NOT added as businesses — they are a different unit of work.

location.area: Khartoum-based; actively markets Port Sudan stock across حي المطار, حي الخليج and سلالاب

crm.notes: A real brokerage actively marketing Port Sudan furnished apartments — daily/monthly/yearly terms, viewing videos on request. Phones and socials are published verbatim in its own post captions. The neighbourhood pass strengthened this materially: its Facebook page (facebook.com/sdamhe.sanhesan, confirmed by fetch to be أملاك العقارية) posts Port Sudan inventory by named district — حي المطار مربع ٤ on شارع السلك, حي الخليج on the main street — and it is listing a four-storey building for sale in سلالاب on alsoug.com. So: headquartered in Khartoum, but genuinely trading Port Sudan stock rather than merely reposting it. Still classified as a channel into the city, not an office in it, until someone confirms a local branch.

Named by the brief. Confirmed as a real mapped place: Waze publishes a directions page for it under sd/red-sea/port-sudan carrying the Google place_id above. Coordinates and phone are NOT public on that page — the place_id is the only hard identifier recovered.

location.area: Port Sudan — ديم مدينة غرب, حي المطار, سلالاب غرب, دبايوا, وسط السوق

crm.notes: The dominant broker on alsoug's Port Sudan property board: advertiser uid 311171 holds **8 of the 12** Port Sudan real-estate ads listed there. Self-described as 'صاحبة شركة تسويق الكتروني — Global Real Estate Marketer' (owner of a digital-marketing company). Posts under two display names — an older 'Hana Abrahim' and the current Arabic form — but the same numeric account id, which is how they were resolved to one advertiser rather than two. Attribution was verified in-browser: every data-user_name element on an advert page carries that page's own data-advert_id, so this is not a related-ads widget bleeding into the parse. No phone is exposed — alsoug puts contact behind a chat button — so reaching them means the platform's own contact flow or a login. Inventory reaches well beyond apartments: one listing is a 15-room, 8-bathroom two-storey building in ديم مدينة غرب at US$4,000/month.
